description: This file implements a Worker class for handling migration jobs in Mattermost, including job execution, cancellation, and status updates.

classes.name: Worker
classes.description: A worker that processes migration jobs, manages job lifecycle including start, stop, cancellation, and status updates.

methods.name: MakeWorker
methods.description: Factory function to create a new Worker instance with initialized channels and dependencies.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Starts the worker loop, processing jobs until stopped.

methods.name: Stop
methods.description: Signals the worker to stop processing jobs and waits for it to finish.

methods.name: JobChannel
methods.description: Returns the channel for submitting jobs to the worker.

methods.name: IsEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the worker is enabled; always returns true.

methods.name: DoJob
methods.description: Executes a given job, handling claim, execution, cancellation, and completion.

methods.name: setJobSuccess
methods.description: Marks a job as successfully completed.

methods.name: setJobError
methods.description: Marks a job as failed with an error.

methods.name: runMigration
methods.description: Runs a specific migration based on the key, updates system state upon completion.
